metadata.name: Sequence
metadata.description: An ordered list of steps behind a typed contract: call other resources, branch on conditions and switches, loop, catch and raise errors, and shape values, then return declared outputs. Runs at startup or is called as a handler, and can stand up resources that live only while it runs.

with.title: With
with.description: Resources that exist only while the sequence runs; created on entry and torn down when it ends.

targets.title: Targets
targets.description: Resources of `with:` started before the steps, each written as a `!ref <name>`.

items.title: Target
items.description: A resource of `with:` to start before the steps, written as a `!ref`.

inputType.title: Input Type
inputType.description: The input contract, a named type or an inline one. The steps read the values as `inputs.<name>`; declared defaults are filled and every call is validated against it.

outputType.title: Output Type
outputType.description: The result contract, a named type or an inline one. It types the result for callers, checks `outputs:` statically, and validates the produced value at every call.

outputs.title: Outputs
outputs.description: The result: a map of values over `steps.*` and `inputs.*`, evaluated after the steps run. Omitted, the result is the map of step results.

steps.title: Steps
steps.description: The steps to run, in order.
